slides.texte_overlay:
Things your future self
will thank you for doing today
Drinking water before your first coffee. It takes ten seconds, and your energy, skin and focus slowly improve over months without you even noticing.
Putting a little money aside. Even a small amount today. Future you will remember the day he finally had a cushion when something went wrong.
Sending that message you keep postponing. The apology, the thank you, the "we should catch up." Relationships are saved by small messages sent on time.
Stretching for five minutes. Hips, back, shoulders. Your body at forty is built by the tiny habits you start at twenty. Start tonight, it's free.
Learning a little today. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and every day it adds a little more to the man I'm becoming.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Every day it adds a little more to the man I'm becoming.

slides.texte_overlay: Going to bed thirty minutes earlier. Tomorrow's patience, focus and mood are mostly decided by tonight's sleep. It's the easiest upgrade there is.
Doing one hard thing before lunch. The call, the workout, the difficult task. Future you will be glad you didn't carry it around all afternoon.
